What's New in v2.8.8

  • Clipboard History reopens with its search, selection, and loaded pages; completed image recognition no longer causes repeated refreshes.
  • Fixed loading, paging, missing-row, and selected-preview races with bounded preview caching.
  • Added a visible window drag area and improved floating-window behavior and active-display positioning.
  • Improved selection contrast, keyboard navigation, searchable commands, sorting, and interaction menus.
  • Smoother optional panes and improved English/Hebrew layouts on smaller displays.
